name: prisma-runtime-layer
description: Shared Lambda layer: the Prisma 7 driver-adapter runtime (Rust-free, WASM query compiler). Mounted at /opt/nodejs/node_modules for s-read, s-replay, monitoring-relay and monitoring-watchdog. NOT a Lambda function.
comment-version-lock: @prisma/client and @prisma/adapter-pg MUST be pinned to the EXACT version used at `prisma generate` in packages/s-ingest-core and packages/monitoring-db. A generated client is version-locked to its runtime. Bump all three together.
